normalization.coverage_semantics: Original plus resumed raw call ledger. Failed calls stay missing; analysis uses normalized Q9.

raw_valid_support_sensitivity.label: Raw-valid-support selection sensitivity using the same normalized scores
raw_valid_support_sensitivity.note: Different sample support; not a correction-effect estimate or unnormalized fit of invalid probabilities.

notes: A-line conditional returner reconstruction; all six months were previously inspected development months.
Per-person-cluster intervals hold months fixed; not a time-generalization claim.
One role-allocation seed, two generations; repeated responses are not new people.
Original raw replies retained; registered proportional normalization applied identically to all arms.
Model/price-view mechanism are fixed across the three arms; no archived DeepSeek control is substituted.

transport_provenance.note: Remaining never-attempted slots use the same client and frozen messages outside the Core loop. Failed requests stay missing, no retries.
